description: Get how Blockchain Academics Stats makes its numbers, for one topic. exchanges: the checks for the 8 centralised exchanges in their fixed wording, the order rule, what each fact is and what each fact status means. vaults: what each figure of a Hyperliquid vault record counts, the ranking floor, what a null means, what the rankings leave out and the totals for all vaults. wallet_lookup: the fields of a lookup record, the rounding, how to read the summary and what the files cannot see. The text is written by Blockchain Academics and comes with the method version or variant and the data day. Works without an API key.
name: get_stats_method
